info.name: Ajaib Coin Exchange Spot Trading API
Retrieve all trades under the exchange client

params.name: from_trade_id
params.description: trade_id to fetch from (exclusive). Returns the most recent trades by default.

items.docs: Retrieves all trades belonging to the exchange client's trading account. Sub-accounts are not supported.

info.name: Retrieve an order under the exchange client

items.docs: Retrieves a single order, based on the input search parameters, belonging to the exchange client's trading account.

info.name: Create a new order under the exchange client

items.docs: Creates a new spot trading order belonging to the exchange client's trading account. A successful response means the exchange has received the order instructions to act upon; it is no guarantee that all instructions have been processed successfully.

info.name: Cancel an order under the exchange client

params.name: order_id
params.description: Unique identifier generated by Ajaib exchange for the order.

items.docs: Cancels or withdraws an open order belonging to the exchange client's trading account. The instruction is valid only for orders with status NEW, OPEN or PARTIALLY_FILLED; otherwise it is rejected automatically.

info.name: Retrieve all open orders under the exchange client

params.name: from_order_id
params.description: order_id to fetch from (inclusive of the starting id). Returns the most recent orders by default in descending order.

items.docs: Retrieves all open orders belonging to the exchange client's trading account. Open orders can only have the statuses NEW, OPEN or PARTIAL_FILLED.

info.name: Cancel all open orders under the exchange client

items.docs: Cancels or withdraws all open orders belonging to the exchange client's trading account for a trading pair.
Creates a new "self-trading" order. Only available for use via an internal market maker exchange client.

info.name: Create multiple new orders from a single request

items.docs: Creates a list of new orders belonging to the exchange client's trading account, allowing a batch of order instructions to be submitted at one go. A successful response means the exchange has received the instructions; it is no guarantee all have been processed successfully.

info.name: Cancel multiple orders under the exchange client

items.docs: Cancels or withdraws a list of orders belonging to the exchange client's trading account in a single request.
